summary: Iteration 24 (Onboarding checklist + Save Today's Notes to a client + View saved notes on client profile) verified end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/backend_iteration24_test.py — POST /api/clients/{id}/notes returns 200 with persistence (verified via GET), empty-string and whitespace-only text return 400, non-existent client returns 404, list returns newest-first order (verified with 3 sequential inserts), DELETE removes the note and returns success, DELETE non-existent note returns 404, unauthenticated request returns 401/403. All responses org-scoped and correctly exclude Mongo _id. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, logged in as TEST_USER_EMAIL, freshly wiped account): (1) onboarding-checklist card visible with 'Getting Started' + progress 'n of 4 done' (started at '1 of 4 done' with business-profile pre-checked because business_name was already set), progress bar renders, all 4 step testIDs (onboarding-profile / onboarding-client / onboarding-invoice / onboarding-assistant) and onboarding-dismiss present, tapping onboarding-client correctly navigated to /clients, completed steps show green checkmark-circle + strikethrough. After creating a client via API, checklist auto-updated to '2 of 4 done' with 'Add your first client' checked. (2) notes-save-client-btn on NotesCard visible; tapping with empty note shows the 'Write or dictate a note first' confirmation dialog (empty-message text matched). (3) After typing a note via notes-inline-input and tapping Save-to-client, the bottom-sheet picker opened showing the client row with correct testID 'notes-client-{id}' and client name; tapping it closed the picker and persisted the note (verified via subsequent GET). (4) On /client/{id}, saved-notes-btn is present in header with a count badge showing '1'; tapping opened the 'Saved Notes' modal listing the dated note ('5 July 2026') with visible text and del-saved-note-{id} delete button. Backend logs clean. Only pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, expo-notifications web token, useNativeDriver on TipsBanner). One new console warning surfaced when the client-detail screen mounts: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' — cosmetic (does not affect rendering), likely a stray whitespace between JSX elements. Reported below.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1255-1285 client_notes endpoints correctly org-scoped (Depends(current_org)), validate client existence before insert (404), reject empty/whitespace text (400 via .strip()), return newest-first sorted list (sort created_at desc), and use ObjectId for delete lookup. doc_out() strips Mongo _id — verified in pytest response.

OnboardingChecklist.tsx logic: all 4 flags derived (profile from settings.abn OR non-default business_name; client/invoice from list length; assistant from AsyncStorage key set on route.push). Auto-hide when all done + DISMISS_KEY persisted via AsyncStorage. useFocusEffect re-loads on every focus — correct for updating after navigation returns.

NotesCard.tsx openPicker correctly guards empty text using stripHtml (handles rich-HTML notes from full editor). Bottom sheet uses Modal (transparent + slide) with backdrop Pressable dismiss. saveToClient shows optimistic loader per row (savingClient state).
client/[id].tsx header packs 3 icon buttons (saved-notes, edit, delete) into a fixed-width headerActions row — could get cramped on narrower devices but at 390 width it fits.
All new interactive elements have testID (onboarding-profile/client/invoice/assistant/dismiss, notes-save-client-btn, notes-client-{id}, saved-notes-btn, del-saved-note-{id}) — matches spec exactly.
No file exceeds 700 lines: OnboardingChecklist.tsx 121 lines, NotesCard.tsx 223 lines, client/[id].tsx 580 lines.

success_rate.frontend: 8/8 flows pass (onboarding-checklist render, progress text, step nav onboarding-client, checked/strikethrough state, empty-note dialog, client picker + persist, saved-notes-btn + badge, modal + delete testid)
